diagnosis: High-grade ductal carcinoma in situ
legend: Extensive necrosis and several small calcifications with two small crowded epithelial tissue fragments of high-grade carcinoma cells with large pleomorphic nuclei. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: High-grade ductal carcinoma in situ
legend: Large cells with moderate N:C ratios, considerable cytoplasm, and large pleomorphic nuclei in a minute tissue fragment with microcalcification. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: High grade DCIS
legend: High grade carcinoma cells with distinct nucleolus. Comedy type necrosis. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST), high-grade
legend: Dispersed single cells with highly pleomorphic nuclei and large single nucleoli, and occasional minute tissue fragments and binucleates. (LBC, Pap)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST) with reactive giant cells
legend: Plentiful dispersed single cells and small tissue fragments, some of which are in runs, with a central multinucleated giant macrophage, in which the nuclei show similar features. The carcinoma cells have high N:C ratios and moderately pleomorphic nuclei. (LBC, Pap)

diagnosis: Medullary pattern carcinoma
legend: Large cells with high N:C ratios, markedly pleomorphic large nuclei, and limited cytoplasm in a syncytial tissue fragment, with occasional similar cells and lymphocytes in the background. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Medullary pattern carcinoma
legend: Large cells with markedly pleomorphic nuclei and prominent single nucleoli, seen singly and in minute tissue fragments, and only scattered small lymphocytes in the background. (LBC, Pap)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST), low-grade
legend: High cellularity with marked dispersal of single cells and discohesive sheets of cells with moderate nuclear enlargement, anisonucleosis, and pleomorphism, and occasional eccentric single vacuoles consistent with low-grade invasive carcinoma. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST), low-grade
legend: Small relatively cohesive tissue fragments and a small number of single dispersed cells with a moderate amount of cytoplasm, and mild nuclear enlargement and atypia of a low- to moderate-grade carcinoma. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST), low-grade
legend: Markedly dispersed single large cells, with eccentric cytoplasm in some cells containing single vacuoles and showing moderate nuclear enlargement and atypia and inconspicuous nucleoli consistent with an intermediate-grade carcinoma. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Medullary pattern carcinoma
legend: Large cells with marked nuclear enlargement and pleomorphism with prominent single nucleoli in tissue fragments and lymphocytes and possible necrosis in the background raising the possibility of medullary pattern carcinoma. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma with malignant giant cells
legend: Large multinucleated giant cells with highly pleomorphic nuclei in a background of dispersed intact cells with moderately atypical nuclei of carcinoma. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST), low-grade
legend: Small minimally crowded tissue fragment with mildly pleomorphic nuclei with small nucleoli. Suggestion of a hard edge and cribriform space, upper right. (Pap)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST), low-grade
legend: Irregular mildly crowded tissue fragment of cells with mildly pleomorphic nuclei, variably granular chromatin, and small nucleoli in some nuclei. No myoepithelial cells on the tissue fragment and no bare bipolar nuclei in the background. (Pap)
source: Mihir Gudi moved from another section, id:86

diagnosis: Medullary pattern carcinoma
legend: Large syncytial tissue fragment of crowded cells showing large pleomorphic nuclei with single large nucleoli, with plentiful lymphocytes infiltrating the tissue fragment and in the background. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Medullary pattern carcinoma
legend: Irregular syncytial tissue fragments of large cells with large pleomorphic nuclei with large single nucleoli. Numerous lymphocytes infiltrate the tissue fragments and are present with occasional single carcinoma cells in the background. (Pap)

diagnosis: Lipid-rich pattern carcinoma
legend: Single dispersed cells and discohesive tissue fragments of cells with abundant eccentric finely vacuolated cytoplasm and moderately pleomorphic nuclei. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Lipid-rich pattern carcinoma
legend: Dispersed single cells and minute discohesive tissue fragments of cells showing abundant finely vacuolated eccentric cytoplasm. (Pap)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST)
legend: Single cells and small discohesive tissue fragments showing abundant eccentric cytoplasm containing small and larger vacuoles in a background that includes fat vacuoles, suggesting secretory change. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST)
legend: Large multinucleated and single cells showing abundant cytoplasm containing a mix of fine and larger vacuoles. (Pap)

diagnosis: Low grade carcinoma
legend: Cohesive mildly crowded tissue fragments of cells with mildly pleomorphic  nuclei and inconspicuous nuclei. No myoepithelial cells are seen on the tissue fragments (Giemsa).

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST), low-grade
legend: Mildly crowded and relatively cohesive small tissue fragments of small to intermediate cells with mild anisonucleosis and nuclear pleomorphism. No myoepithelial nuclei are present on the tissue fragments. (Giemsa)

diagnosis: Suspicious for malignancy.
legend: Fragments of atypical apocrine epithelial cells with a background of some debris and a few histiocytes. A slightly higher nuclear to cytoplasmic ratio is noted (Giemsa). Histology showed apocrine encapsulated papillary carcinoma.

diagnosis: Invasive carcinoma of no special type (NST)
legend: Fibroblastic collagenous tissue fragment infiltrated by epithelial cells similar to those in the epithelial tissue fragment, demonstrating invasion. (Giemsa)
